before: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made them.
after: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made them.

before: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted, for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
after: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted, for Yahweh God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.

before: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
after: Then Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.

before: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
after: And Yahweh God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.

before: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
after: Out of the ground Yahweh God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

before: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
after: Then Yahweh God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

before: And the LORD God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,
after: And Yahweh God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,

before: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
after: Yahweh God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”

before: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
after: And out of the ground Yahweh God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

before: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
after: So Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.

before: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
after: And from the rib that Yahweh God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.

before: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”
after: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that Yahweh God had made. And he said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”

before: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
after: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of Yahweh God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

before: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
after: But Yahweh God called out to the man, “Where are you?”

before: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
after: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked Yahweh God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”

before: Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” “The serpent deceived me,” she replied, “and I ate.”
after: Then Yahweh God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” “The serpent deceived me,” she replied, “and I ate.”

before: So the LORD God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.
after: So Yahweh God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.

before: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.
after: And Yahweh God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.

before: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
after: Then Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”

before: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
after: Therefore Yahweh God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

before: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
after: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of Yahweh I have brought forth a man,” she said.

before: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
after: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to Yahweh,

before: while Abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock. And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
after: while Abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock. And Yahweh looked with favor on Abel and his offering,

before: “Why are you angry,” said the LORD to Cain, “and why has your countenance fallen?
after: “Why are you angry,” said Yahweh to Cain, “and why has your countenance fallen?

before: And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
after: And Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”

before: “What have you done?” replied the LORD. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
after: “What have you done?” replied Yahweh. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.

before: But Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
after: But Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

before: “Not so!” replied the LORD. “If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” And the LORD placed a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
after: “Not so!” replied Yahweh. “If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” And Yahweh placed a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.

before: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
after: So Cain went out from the presence of Yahweh and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

before: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
after: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of Yahweh.

before: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
after: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that Yahweh has cursed.”

before: So the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”
after: So Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”

before: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
after: Then Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.

before: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
after: And Yahweh regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.

before: So the LORD said, “I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.”
after: So Yahweh said, “I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.”

before: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
after: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of Yahweh.

before: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
after: Then Yahweh said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

before: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
after: And Noah did all that Yahweh had commanded him.

before: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
after: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then Yahweh shut him in.

before: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
after: Then Noah built an altar to Yahweh. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.

before: When the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, He said in His heart, “Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.
after: When Yahweh smelled the pleasing aroma, He said in His heart, “Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.

before: He also declared: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
after: He also declared: “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.

before: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
after: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh.”

before: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
after: Then Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.

before: And the LORD said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
after: And Yahweh said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.

before: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
after: So Yahweh scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

before: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.
after: That is why it is called Babel, for there Yahweh confused the language of the whole world, and from that place Yahweh scattered them over the face of all the earth.

before: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
after: Then Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.

before: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
after: So Abram departed, as Yahweh had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.

before: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
after: Then Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” So Abram built an altar there to Yahweh, who had appeared to him.

before: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.
after: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh, and he called on the name of Yahweh.

before: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
after: Yahweh, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.

before: to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
after: to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of Yahweh.

before: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
after: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt. (This was before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)

before: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the LORD.
after: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against Yahweh.

before: After Lot had departed, the LORD said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,
after: After Lot had departed, Yahweh said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,

before: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
after: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to Yahweh.

before: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
after: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to Yahweh God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

before: After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
after: After these events, the word of Yahweh came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”

before: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
after: But Abram replied, “O Lord Yahweh, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”

before: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
after: Then the word of Yahweh came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”

before: And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
after: And Yahweh took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”

before: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
after: Abram believed Yahweh, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

before: The LORD also told him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”
after: Yahweh also told him, “I am Yahweh, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”

before: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
after: But Abram replied, “Lord Yahweh, how can I know that I will possess it?”

before: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
after: And Yahweh said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”

before: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
after: Then Yahweh said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

before: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
after: On that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—

before: So Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
after: So Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, Yahweh has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

before: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
after: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May Yahweh judge between you and me.”

before: Now the angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert—the spring along the road to Shur.
after: Now the angel of Yahweh found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert—the spring along the road to Shur.

before: So the angel of the LORD told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”
after: So the angel of Yahweh told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”

before: The angel of the LORD proceeded: “Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.
after: The angel of Yahweh proceeded: “Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for Yahweh has heard your cry of affliction.

before: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me,” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”
after: So Hagar gave this name to Yahweh who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me,” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”

before: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.
after: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.

before: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
after: Then Yahweh appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.

before: Then the LORD said, “I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!” Now Sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.
after: Then Yahweh said, “I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!” Now Sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.

before: And the LORD asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’
after: And Yahweh asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’

before: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
after: Is anything too difficult for Yahweh? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”

before: But Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, “I did not laugh.” “No,” replied the LORD, “but you did laugh.”
after: But Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, “I did not laugh.” “No,” replied Yahweh, “but you did laugh.”

before: And the LORD said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
after: And Yahweh said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

before: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.”
after: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of Yahweh by doing what is right and just, in order that Yahweh may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.”

before: Then the LORD said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,
after: Then Yahweh said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,

before: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the LORD.
after: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before Yahweh.

before: So the LORD replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”
after: So Yahweh replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”

before: Once again Abraham spoke to the LORD, “Suppose forty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”
after: Once again Abraham spoke to Yahweh, “Suppose forty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”

before: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.
after: When Yahweh had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.

before: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
after: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to Yahweh against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”

before: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
after: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for Yahweh is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.

before: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.
after: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of Yahweh’s compassion for them.

before: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
after: Then Yahweh rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from Yahweh out of the heavens.

before: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
after: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

before: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
after: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, Yahweh had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.

before: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised.
after: Now Yahweh attended to Sarah as He had said, and Yahweh did for Sarah what He had promised.

before: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
after: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of Yahweh, the Eternal God.

before: Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
after: Just then the angel of Yahweh called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.

before: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
after: And Abraham called that place Yahweh Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of Yahweh it will be provided.”

before: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,
after: And the angel of Yahweh called to Abraham from heaven a second time,

before: saying, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
after: saying, “By Myself I have sworn, declares Yahweh, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,

before: By now Abraham was old and well along in years, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.
after: By now Abraham was old and well along in years, and Yahweh had blessed him in every way.

before: and I will have you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,
after: and I will have you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,

before: The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.
after: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.

before: “O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
after: “O Yahweh, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

before: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
after: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not Yahweh had made his journey a success.

before: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,
after: Then the man bowed down and worshiped Yahweh,

before: saying, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
after: saying, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”

before: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
after: “Come, you who are blessed by Yahweh,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”

before: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
after: “Yahweh has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.

before: And he told me, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.
after: And he told me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.

before: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!
