before: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
after: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that Yahweh your God is giving you for all time.

before: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
after: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

before: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.
after: Yahweh spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

before: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:
after: At that time I was standing between Yahweh and you to declare to you the word of Yahweh, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:

before: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
after: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

before: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
after: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,

before: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
after: You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain, for Yahweh will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.

before: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
after: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as Yahweh your God has commanded you.

before: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.
after: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.

before: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
after: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that Yahweh your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why Yahweh your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

before: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
after: Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that Yahweh your God is giving you.

before: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
after: Yahweh spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

before: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
after: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

before: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
after: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of Yahweh our God any longer.

before: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
after: Go near and listen to all that Yahweh our God says. Then you can tell us everything Yahweh our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”

before: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
after: And Yahweh heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.

before: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
after: So be careful to do as Yahweh your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.

before: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
after: You must walk in all the ways that Yahweh your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

before: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,
after: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that Yahweh your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,

before: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
after: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear Yahweh your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.

before: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
after: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

before: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
after: Hear, O Israel: Yahweh our God, Yahweh is One.

before: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
after: And you shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

before: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,
after: And when Yahweh your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,

before: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
after: be careful not to forget Yahweh who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

before: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
after: Fear Yahweh your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.

before: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
after: For Yahweh your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of Yahweh your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.

before: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
after: Do not test Yahweh your God as you tested Him at Massah.

before: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
after: You are to diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.

before: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers,
after: Do what is right and good in the sight of Yahweh, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that Yahweh your God swore to give your fathers,

before: driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said.
after: driving out all your enemies before you, as Yahweh has said.

before: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”
after: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that Yahweh our God has commanded you?”

before: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
after: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

before: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.
after: Before our eyes Yahweh inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.

before: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
after: And Yahweh commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear Yahweh our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.

before: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
after: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before Yahweh our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”

before: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
after: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—

before: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
after: and when Yahweh your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.

before: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
after: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of Yahweh will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.

before: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
after: For you are a people holy to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.

before: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
after: Yahweh did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

before: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
after: But because Yahweh loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

before: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
after: Know therefore that Yahweh your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.

before: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
after: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then Yahweh your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.

before: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
after: And Yahweh will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.

before: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
after: You must destroy all the peoples Yahweh your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

before: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
after: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:

before: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
after: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which Yahweh your God brought you out. Yahweh your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

before: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
after: Moreover, Yahweh your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.

before: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
after: Do not be terrified by them, for Yahweh your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

before: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
after: Yahweh your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.

before: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
after: But Yahweh your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.

before: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
after: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to Yahweh your God.

before: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
after: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that Yahweh swore to give your fathers.

before: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
after: Remember that these forty years Yahweh your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.

before: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
after: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of Yahweh.

before: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
after: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

before: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
after: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.

before: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
after: For Yahweh your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;

before: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
after: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless Yahweh your God for the good land that He has given you.

before: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
after: Be careful not to forget Yahweh your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.

before: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
after: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget Yahweh your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

before: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
after: But remember that it is Yahweh your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.

before: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
after: If you ever forget Yahweh your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.

before: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
after: Like the nations that Yahweh has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey Yahweh your God.

before: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the LORD has promised you.
after: But understand that today Yahweh your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as Yahweh has promised you.

before: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.
after: When Yahweh your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, Yahweh is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.

before: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
after: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that Yahweh your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

before: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.
after: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that Yahweh your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

before: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the LORD.
after: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked Yahweh your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against Yahweh.

before: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
after: At Horeb you provoked Yahweh, and He was angry enough to destroy you.

before: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.
after: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that Yahweh made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.

before: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
after: Then Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that Yahweh spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.

before: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
after: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

before: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
after: And Yahweh said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”

before: The LORD also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
after: Yahweh also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

before: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.
after: And I saw how you had sinned against Yahweh your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that Yahweh had commanded you.

before: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
after: Then I fell down before Yahweh for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of Yahweh and provoking Him to anger.

before: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me this time as well.
after: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that Yahweh had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me this time as well.

before: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.
after: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.

before: You continued to provoke the LORD at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.
after: You continued to provoke Yahweh at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.

before: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.
after: And when Yahweh sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of Yahweh your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.

before: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you.
after: You have been rebelling against Yahweh since the day I came to know you.

before: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
after: So I fell down before Yahweh for forty days and forty nights, because Yahweh had said He would destroy you.

before: And I prayed to the LORD and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
after: And I prayed to Yahweh and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

before: And I prayed to Yahweh and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
after: And I prayed to Yahweh and said, “O Lord Yahweh, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

before: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
after: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

before: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
after: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

before: And the LORD wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. The LORD gave them to me,
after: And Yahweh wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. Yahweh gave them to me,

before: and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD had commanded me; and there they have remained.
after: and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as Yahweh had commanded me; and there they have remained.

before: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.
after: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, to stand before Yahweh to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.

before: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.
after: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, as Yahweh your God promised him.

before: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.
after: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time Yahweh again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.

before: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”
after: Then Yahweh said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”

before: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
after: And now, O Israel, what does Yahweh your God ask of you but to fear Yahweh your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

before: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
after: and to keep the commandments and statutes of Yahweh that I am giving you this day for your own good?

before: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
after: Behold, to Yahweh your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.

before: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.
after: Yet Yahweh has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.

before: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
after: For Yahweh your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.

before: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
after: You are to fear Yahweh your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.

before: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.
after: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now Yahweh your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

before: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
after: You shall therefore love Yahweh your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.

before: Know this day that it is not your children who have known and seen the discipline of the LORD your God: His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm;
after: Know this day that it is not your children who have known and seen the discipline of Yahweh your God: His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm;

before: For it is your own eyes that have seen every great work that the LORD has done.
after: For it is your own eyes that have seen every great work that Yahweh has done.

before: and so that you may live long in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
after: and so that you may live long in the land that Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

before: It is a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God are always on it, from the beginning to the end of the year.
after: It is a land for which Yahweh your God cares; the eyes of Yahweh your God are always on it, from the beginning to the end of the year.

before: So if you carefully obey the commandments I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
after: So if you carefully obey the commandments I am giving you today, to love Yahweh your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

before: or the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you. He will shut the heavens so that there will be no rain, nor will the land yield its produce, and you will soon perish from the good land that the LORD is giving you.
after: or the anger of Yahweh will be kindled against you. He will shut the heavens so that there will be no rain, nor will the land yield its produce, and you will soon perish from the good land that Yahweh is giving you.

before: so that as long as the heavens are above the earth, your days and those of your children may be multiplied in the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
after: so that as long as the heavens are above the earth, your days and those of your children may be multiplied in the land that Yahweh swore to give your fathers.

before: For if you carefully keep all these commandments I am giving you to follow—to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him—
after: For if you carefully keep all these commandments I am giving you to follow—to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all His ways, and to hold fast to Him—

before: then the LORD will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations greater and stronger than you.
after: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations greater and stronger than you.

before: No man will be able to stand against you; the LORD your God will put the fear and dread of you upon all the land, wherever you set foot, as He has promised you.
after: No man will be able to stand against you; Yahweh your God will put the fear and dread of you upon all the land, wherever you set foot, as He has promised you.

before: a blessing if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you today,
after: a blessing if you obey the commandments of Yahweh your God that I am giving you today,

before: but a curse if you disobey the commandments of the LORD your God and turn aside from the path I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.
after: but a curse if you disobey the commandments of Yahweh your God and turn aside from the path I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

before: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
after: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

before: For you are about to cross the Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you. When you take possession of it and settle in it,
after: For you are about to cross the Jordan to enter and possess the land that Yahweh your God is giving you. When you take possession of it and settle in it,

before: These are the statutes and ordinances you must be careful to follow all the days you live in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess.
after: These are the statutes and ordinances you must be careful to follow all the days you live in the land that Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess.

before: You shall not worship the LORD your God in this way.
after: You shall not worship Yahweh your God in this way.

before: Instead, you must seek the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes to establish as a dwelling for His Name, and there you must go.
after: Instead, you must seek the place Yahweh your God will choose from among all your tribes to establish as a dwelling for His Name, and there you must go.

before: There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your households shall eat and rejoice in all you do, because the LORD your God has blessed you.
after: There, in the presence of Yahweh your God, you and your households shall eat and rejoice in all you do, because Yahweh your God has blessed you.

before: For you have not yet come to the resting place and the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.
after: For you have not yet come to the resting place and the inheritance that Yahweh your God is giving you.

before: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all the enemies around you and you dwell securely,
after: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land that Yahweh your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all the enemies around you and you dwell securely,

before: then the LORD your God will choose a dwelling for His Name. And there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice offerings you vow to the LORD.
after: then Yahweh your God will choose a dwelling for His Name. And there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice offerings you vow to Yahweh.

before: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance among you.
after: And you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance among you.

before: you must offer them only in the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribal territories, and there you shall do all that I command you.
after: you must offer them only in the place Yahweh will choose in one of your tribal territories, and there you shall do all that I command you.

before: But whenever you want, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Both the ceremonially clean and unclean may eat it as they would a gazelle or deer,
after: But whenever you want, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, according to the blessing Yahweh your God has given you. Both the ceremonially clean and unclean may eat it as they would a gazelle or deer,

before: Instead, you must eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates. Rejoice before the LORD your God in all you do,
after: Instead, you must eat them in the presence of Yahweh your God at the place Yahweh your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates. Rejoice before Yahweh your God in all you do,

before: When the LORD your God expands your territory as He has promised, and you crave meat and say, “I want to eat meat,” you may eat it whenever you want.
after: When Yahweh your God expands your territory as He has promised, and you crave meat and say, “I want to eat meat,” you may eat it whenever you want.

before: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put His Name is too far from you, then you may slaughter any of the herd or flock He has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat it within your gates whenever you want.
after: If the place where Yahweh your God chooses to put His Name is too far from you, then you may slaughter any of the herd or flock He has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat it within your gates whenever you want.

before: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
after: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of Yahweh.

before: But you are to take your holy things and your vow offerings and go to the place the LORD will choose.
after: But you are to take your holy things and your vow offerings and go to the place Yahweh will choose.

before: Present the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.
after: Present the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of Yahweh your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out beside the altar of Yahweh your God, but you may eat the meat.

before: Be careful to obey all these things I command you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
after: Be careful to obey all these things I command you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of Yahweh your God.

before: When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations you are entering to dispossess, and you drive them out and live in their land,
after: When Yahweh your God cuts off before you the nations you are entering to dispossess, and you drive them out and live in their land,

before: You must not worship the LORD your God in this way, because they practice for their gods every abomination which the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.
after: You must not worship Yahweh your God in this way, because they practice for their gods every abomination which Yahweh hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

before: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. For the LORD your God is testing you to find out whether you love Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
after: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. For Yahweh your God is testing you to find out whether you love Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

before: You are to follow the LORD your God and fear Him. Keep His commandments and listen to His voice; serve Him and hold fast to Him.
after: You are to follow Yahweh your God and fear Him. Keep His commandments and listen to His voice; serve Him and hold fast to Him.

before: Such a prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has advocated rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way in which the LORD your God has commanded you to walk. So you must purge the evil from among you.
after: Such a prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has advocated rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way in which Yahweh your God has commanded you to walk. So you must purge the evil from among you.

before: Stone him to death for trying to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
after: Stone him to death for trying to turn you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

before: If, regarding one of the cities the LORD your God is giving you to inhabit, you hear it said
after: If, regarding one of the cities Yahweh your God is giving you to inhabit, you hear it said

before: And you are to gather all its plunder in the middle of the public square, and completely burn the city and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God. The city must remain a mound of ruins forever, never to be rebuilt.
after: And you are to gather all its plunder in the middle of the public square, and completely burn the city and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to Yahweh your God. The city must remain a mound of ruins forever, never to be rebuilt.

before: Nothing devoted to destruction shall cling to your hands, so that the LORD will turn from His fierce anger, grant you mercy, show you compassion, and multiply you as He swore to your fathers,
after: Nothing devoted to destruction shall cling to your hands, so that Yahweh will turn from His fierce anger, grant you mercy, show you compassion, and multiply you as He swore to your fathers,

before: because you obey the LORD your God, keeping all His commandments I am giving you today and doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
after: because you obey Yahweh your God, keeping all His commandments I am giving you today and doing what is right in the eyes of Yahweh your God.

before: You are sons of the LORD your God; do not cut yourselves or shave your foreheads on behalf of the dead,
after: You are sons of Yahweh your God; do not cut yourselves or shave your foreheads on behalf of the dead,

before: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all the peoples on the face of the earth.
after: for you are a people holy to Yahweh your God. Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all the peoples on the face of the earth.

before: You are not to eat any carcass; you may give it to the foreigner residing within your gates, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. For you are a holy people belonging to the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
after: You are not to eat any carcass; you may give it to the foreigner residing within your gates, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. For you are a holy people belonging to Yahweh your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

before: And you are to eat a tenth of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks, in the presence of the LORD your God at the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name, so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.
after: And you are to eat a tenth of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks, in the presence of Yahweh your God at the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name, so that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

before: But if the distance is too great for you to carry that with which the LORD your God has blessed you, because the place where the LORD your God will choose to put His Name is too far away,
after: But if the distance is too great for you to carry that with which Yahweh your God has blessed you, because the place where Yahweh your God will choose to put His Name is too far away,

before: then exchange it for money, take the money in your hand, and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.
after: then exchange it for money, take the money in your hand, and go to the place Yahweh your God will choose.

before: Then you may spend the money on anything you desire: cattle, sheep, wine, strong drink, or anything you wish. You are to feast there in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice with your household.
after: Then you may spend the money on anything you desire: cattle, sheep, wine, strong drink, or anything you wish. You are to feast there in the presence of Yahweh your God and rejoice with your household.

before: Then the Levite (because he has no portion or inheritance among you), the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow within your gates may come and eat and be satisfied. And the LORD your God will bless you in all the work of your hands.
after: Then the Levite (because he has no portion or inheritance among you), the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow within your gates may come and eat and be satisfied. And Yahweh your God will bless you in all the work of your hands.

before: This is the manner of remission: Every creditor shall cancel what he has loaned to his neighbor. He is not to collect anything from his neighbor or brother, because the LORD’s time of release has been proclaimed.
after: This is the manner of remission: Every creditor shall cancel what he has loaned to his neighbor. He is not to collect anything from his neighbor or brother, because Yahweh’s time of release has been proclaimed.

before: There will be no poor among you, however, because the LORD will surely bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance,
after: There will be no poor among you, however, because Yahweh will surely bless you in the land that Yahweh your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance,

before: if only you obey the LORD your God and are careful to follow all these commandments I am giving you today.
after: if only you obey Yahweh your God and are careful to follow all these commandments I am giving you today.

before: When the LORD your God blesses you as He has promised, you will lend to many nations but borrow from none; you will rule over many nations but be ruled by none.
after: When Yahweh your God blesses you as He has promised, you will lend to many nations but borrow from none; you will rule over many nations but be ruled by none.

before: If there is a poor man among your brothers within any of the gates in the land that the LORD your God is giving you, then you are not to harden your heart or shut your hand from your poor brother.
after: If there is a poor man among your brothers within any of the gates in the land that Yahweh your God is giving you, then you are not to harden your heart or shut your hand from your poor brother.

before: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought in your heart: “The seventh year, the year of release, is near,” so that you look upon your poor brother begrudgingly and give him nothing. He will cry out to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.
after: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought in your heart: “The seventh year, the year of release, is near,” so that you look upon your poor brother begrudgingly and give him nothing. He will cry out to Yahweh against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

before: Give generously to him, and do not let your heart be grieved when you do so. And because of this the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything to which you put your hand.
after: Give generously to him, and do not let your heart be grieved when you do so. And because of this Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in everything to which you put your hand.

before: You are to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. You shall give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.
after: You are to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. You shall give to him as Yahweh your God has blessed you.

before: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; that is why I am giving you this command today.
after: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you; that is why I am giving you this command today.

before: Do not regard it as a hardship to set your servant free, because his six years of service were worth twice the wages of a hired hand. And the LORD your God will bless you in all you do.
after: Do not regard it as a hardship to set your servant free, because his six years of service were worth twice the wages of a hired hand. And Yahweh your God will bless you in all you do.

before: You must set apart to the LORD your God every firstborn male produced by your herds and flocks. You are not to put the firstborn of your oxen to work, nor are you to shear the firstborn of your flock.
after: You must set apart to Yahweh your God every firstborn male produced by your herds and flocks. You are not to put the firstborn of your oxen to work, nor are you to shear the firstborn of your flock.

before: Each year you and your household are to eat it before the LORD your God in the place the LORD will choose.
after: Each year you and your household are to eat it before Yahweh your God in the place Yahweh will choose.

before: But if an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
after: But if an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

before: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
after: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to Yahweh your God, because in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

before: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name.
after: You are to offer to Yahweh your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place Yahweh will choose as a dwelling for His Name.

before: You are not to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you.
after: You are not to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that Yahweh your God is giving you.

before: You must only offer the Passover sacrifice at the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name. Do this in the evening as the sun sets, at the same time you departed from Egypt.
after: You must only offer the Passover sacrifice at the place Yahweh your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name. Do this in the evening as the sun sets, at the same time you departed from Egypt.

before: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place the LORD your God will choose, and in the morning you shall return to your tents.
after: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place Yahweh your God will choose, and in the morning you shall return to your tents.

before: For six days you must eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God, and you must not do any work.
after: For six days you must eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God, and you must not do any work.

before: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you,
after: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to Yahweh your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how Yahweh your God has blessed you,

before: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
after: and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.

before: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.
after: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to Yahweh your God in the place He will choose, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.

before: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed.
after: Three times a year all your men are to appear before Yahweh your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before Yahweh empty-handed.

before: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you.
after: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing Yahweh your God has given you.

before: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
after: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that Yahweh your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.

before: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
after: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that Yahweh your God is giving you.

before: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
after: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for Yahweh your God,

before: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
after: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which Yahweh your God hates.

before: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the LORD your God.
after: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to Yahweh your God.

before: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the LORD your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God by transgressing His covenant
after: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that Yahweh your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of Yahweh your God by transgressing His covenant

before: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose.
after: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place Yahweh your God will choose.

before: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,
after: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place Yahweh will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,

before: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve the LORD your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.
after: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve Yahweh your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

before: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”
after: When you enter the land that Yahweh your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”

before: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom the LORD your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.
after: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom Yahweh your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.

before: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the LORD has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’
after: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for Yahweh has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’

before: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.
after: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.

before: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the food offerings to the LORD; that is their inheritance.
after: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the food offerings to Yahweh; that is their inheritance.

before: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them.
after: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, Yahweh is their inheritance, as He promised them.

before: For the LORD your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.
after: For Yahweh your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.

before: Now if a Levite moves from any town of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,
after: Now if a Levite moves from any town of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness to the place Yahweh will choose,

before: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.
after: then he shall serve in the name of Yahweh his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before Yahweh.

before: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
after: When you enter the land that Yahweh your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

before: For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD. And because of these detestable things, the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you.
after: For whoever does these things is detestable to Yahweh. And because of these detestable things, Yahweh your God is driving out the nations before you.

before: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.
after: You must be blameless before Yahweh your God.

before: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

after: And he did evil in the sight of Yahweh, just as his father had done.
