after: As Yahweh had declared, Nebuchadnezzar also carried off all the treasures from the house of Yahweh and the royal palace, and he cut into pieces all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of Yahweh.

before: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
after: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of Yahweh, just as Jehoiakim had done.

before: For because of the anger of the LORD, all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He finally banished them from His presence. And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon.
after: For because of the anger of Yahweh, all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He finally banished them from His presence. And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon.

before: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
after: He burned down the house of Yahweh, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.

before: Moreover, the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and stands and the bronze Sea in the house of the LORD, and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
after: Moreover, the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and stands and the bronze Sea in the house of Yahweh, and they carried the bronze to Babylon.

before: As for the two pillars, the Sea, and the movable stands that Solomon had made for the house of the LORD, the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure.
after: As for the two pillars, the Sea, and the movable stands that Solomon had made for the house of Yahweh, the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure.

before: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
after: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahweh. So Yahweh put him to death.

before: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
after: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

before: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
after: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of Yahweh after the ark rested there.

before: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
after: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.

before: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
after: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of Yahweh.

before: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
after: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and Yahweh was with him.

before: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
after: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of Yahweh—the house called the Tent.

before: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
after: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to Yahweh, because he did not keep the word of Yahweh and even consulted a medium for guidance,

before: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
after: and he failed to inquire of Yahweh. So Yahweh put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

before: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
after: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And Yahweh your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”

before: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel.
after: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before Yahweh. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of Yahweh through Samuel.

before: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
after: And David became greater and greater, for Yahweh of Hosts was with him.

before: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
after: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of Yahweh concerning Israel.

before: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
after: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and Yahweh brought about a great victory.

before: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
after: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to Yahweh,

before: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD:
after: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of Yahweh:

before: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
after: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of Yahweh our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.

before: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
after: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God Yahweh, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.

before: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
after: And the anger of Yahweh burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.

before: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
after: Then David became angry because Yahweh had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.

before: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he owned.
after: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and Yahweh blessed his household and everything he owned.

before: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
after: And David realized that Yahweh had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.

before: So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”
after: So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied Yahweh, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”

before: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
after: And David’s fame went out into every land, and Yahweh caused all nations to fear him.

before: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.”
after: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because Yahweh has chosen them to carry the ark of Yahweh and to minister before Him forever.”

before: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
after: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of Yahweh to the place he had prepared for it.

before: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
after: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

before: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
after: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that Yahweh our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”

before: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
after: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

before: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
after: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of Yahweh.

before: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom.
after: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of Yahweh from the house of Obed-edom.

before: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
after: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

before: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
after: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.

before: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.
after: As the ark of the covenant of Yahweh was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.

before: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
after: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh.

before: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
after: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of Yahweh, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel.

before: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:
after: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to Yahweh:

before: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
after: “Give thanks to Yahweh; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

before: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
after: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

before: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
after: Seek out Yahweh and His strength; seek His face always.

before: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
after: He is Yahweh our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

before: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
after: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.

before: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
after: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.

before: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
after: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is Yahweh who made the heavens.

before: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
after: Ascribe to Yahweh, O families of the nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

before: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
after: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship Yahweh in the splendor of His holiness;

before: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
after: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘Yahweh reigns!’

before: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
after: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for He is coming to judge the earth.

before: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
after: Give thanks to Yahweh, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

before: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!”
after: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise Yahweh!”

before: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
after: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,

before: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
after: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of Yahweh at the high place in Gibeon

before: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
after: to regularly present burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of Yahweh, which He had commanded Israel to keep.

before: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
after: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to Yahweh, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”

before: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
after: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of Yahweh is under a tent.”

before: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.
after: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what Yahweh says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.

before: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
after: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what Yahweh of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.

before: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
after: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that Yahweh will build a house for you.

before: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
after: Then King David went in, sat before Yahweh, and said, “Who am I, O Yahweh God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

before: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
after: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O Yahweh God.

before: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and made known all these great promises.
after: O Yahweh. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and made known all these great promises.

before: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
after: O Yahweh, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.

before: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
after: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O Yahweh, have become their God.

before: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
after: And now, O Yahweh, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,

before: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
after: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.

before: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
after: And now, O Yahweh, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.

before: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
after: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O Yahweh, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”

before: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
after: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So Yahweh made David victorious wherever he went.

before: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
after: and King David dedicated these to Yahweh, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.

before: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
after: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So Yahweh made David victorious wherever he went.

before: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
after: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do what is good in His sight.”

before: But Joab replied, “May the LORD multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”
after: But Joab replied, “May Yahweh multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”

before: And the LORD instructed Gad, David’s seer,
after: And Yahweh instructed Gad, David’s seer,

before: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”
after: “Go and tell David that this is what Yahweh says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”

before: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
after: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘You must choose

before: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of the LORD—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”
after: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of Yahweh—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of Yahweh ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”

before: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”
after: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of Yahweh, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”

before: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
after: So Yahweh sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.

before: Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!” At that time the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
after: Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, Yahweh saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!” At that time the angel of Yahweh was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

before: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
after: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of Yahweh standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

before: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.”
after: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O Yahweh my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.”

before: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
after: Then the angel of Yahweh ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

before: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.
after: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of Yahweh.

before: Then David said to Ornan, “Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.”
after: Then David said to Ornan, “Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.”

before: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
after: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for Yahweh what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”

before: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon the LORD, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
after: And there he built an altar to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon Yahweh, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

before: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, who put his sword back into its sheath.
after: Then Yahweh spoke to the angel, who put his sword back into its sheath.

before: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
after: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

before: For the tabernacle of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,
after: For the tabernacle of Yahweh that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,

before: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
after: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of Yahweh.

before: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
after: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of Yahweh God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

before: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
after: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.

before: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
after: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

before: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
after: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of Yahweh my God,

before: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
after: but this word of Yahweh came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.

before: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
after: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of Yahweh your God, as He said you would.

before: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.

after: Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her. For he said, “My wife must not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of Yahweh has entered are holy.”

before: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD he had built in front of the portico.
after: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of Yahweh he had built in front of the portico.

before: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out, from the day the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.
after: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out, from the day the foundation was laid for the house of Yahweh until it was finished. So the house of Yahweh was completed.

before: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants, the attire of his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
after: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants, the attire of his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of Yahweh, it took her breath away.

before: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.”
after: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for Yahweh your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.”

before: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had anything like them been seen in the land of Judah.)
after: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of Yahweh and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had anything like them been seen in the land of Judah.)

before: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from God, in order that the LORD might fulfill the word that He had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.
after: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from God, in order that Yahweh might fulfill the word that He had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.

before: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:
after: But the word of Yahweh came to Shemaiah the man of God:

before: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this is My doing.’” So they listened to the words of the LORD and turned back from going against Jeroboam.
after: that this is what Yahweh says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this is My doing.’” So they listened to the words of Yahweh and turned back from going against Jeroboam.

before: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.
after: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of Yahweh.

before: Those from every tribe of Israel who had set their hearts to seek the LORD their God followed the Levites to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
after: Those from every tribe of Israel who had set their hearts to seek Yahweh their God followed the Levites to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

before: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of the LORD.
after: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of Yahweh.

before: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem
after: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, because they had been unfaithful to Yahweh, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem

before: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You have forsaken Me; therefore, I have forsaken you into the hand of Shishak.’”
after: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘You have forsaken Me; therefore, I have forsaken you into the hand of Shishak.’”

before: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is righteous.”
after: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “Yahweh is righteous.”

before: When the LORD saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
after: When Yahweh saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of Yahweh came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.

before: So King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem and seized the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields that Solomon had made.
after: So King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem and seized the treasures of the house of Yahweh and of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields that Solomon had made.

before: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would go with him, bearing the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
after: And whenever the king entered the house of Yahweh, the guards would go with him, bearing the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.

before: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the anger of the LORD turned away from him, and He did not destroy him completely. Indeed, conditions were good in Judah.
after: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the anger of Yahweh turned away from him, and He did not destroy him completely. Indeed, conditions were good in Judah.

before: Thus King Rehoboam established himself in Jerusalem and reigned. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
after: Thus King Rehoboam established himself in Jerusalem and reigned. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city Yahweh had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.

before: And Rehoboam did evil because he did not set his heart to seek the LORD.
after: And Rehoboam did evil because he did not set his heart to seek Yahweh.

before: Do you not know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?
after: Do you not know that Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?

before: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.
after: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of Yahweh, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.

before: But did you not drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? And did you not make priests for yourselves as do the peoples of other lands? Now whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of things that are not gods.
after: But did you not drive out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? And did you not make priests for yourselves as do the peoples of other lands? Now whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of things that are not gods.

before: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
after: But as for us, Yahweh is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to Yahweh are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.

before: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of the LORD our God, while you have forsaken Him.
after: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to Yahweh. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of Yahweh our God, while you have forsaken Him.

before: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”
after: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”

before: When Judah turned and discovered that the battle was both before and behind them, they cried out to the LORD. Then the priests blew the trumpets,
after: When Judah turned and discovered that the battle was both before and behind them, they cried out to Yahweh. Then the priests blew the trumpets,

before: Thus the Israelites were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
after: Thus the Israelites were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed because they relied on Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

before: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and the LORD struck him down and he died.
after: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and Yahweh struck him down and he died.

before: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
after: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of Yahweh his God.

before: He commanded the people of Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandments.
after: He commanded the people of Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandments.

before: Because the land was at peace, Asa built fortified cities in Judah. In those days no one made war with him, because the LORD had given him rest.
after: Because the land was at peace, Asa built fortified cities in Judah. In those days no one made war with him, because Yahweh had given him rest.

before: So he said to the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
after: So he said to the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought Yahweh our God. We have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

before: Then Asa cried out to the LORD his God: “O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.”
after: Then Asa cried out to Yahweh his God: “O Yahweh, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O Yahweh our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O Yahweh, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.”

before: So the LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.
after: So Yahweh struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.

before: Then Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. The Cushites fell and could not recover, for they were crushed before the LORD and His army. So the people of Judah carried off a great amount of plunder
after: Then Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. The Cushites fell and could not recover, for they were crushed before Yahweh and His army. So the people of Judah carried off a great amount of plunder

before: and attacked all the cities around Gerar, because the terror of the LORD had fallen upon them. They plundered all the cities, since there was much plunder there.
after: and attacked all the cities around Gerar, because the terror of Yahweh had fallen upon them. They plundered all the cities, since there was much plunder there.

before: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
after: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. Yahweh is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.

before: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.
after: But in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.

before: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage and removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple.
after: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage and removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of Yahweh that was in front of the portico of Yahweh’s temple.

before: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin, along with those from the tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who had settled among them, for great numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
after: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin, along with those from the tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who had settled among them, for great numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

before: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from all the plunder they had brought back.
after: At that time they sacrificed to Yahweh seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from all the plunder they had brought back.

before: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and soul.
after: Then they entered into a covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and soul.

before: And whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, would be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.
after: And whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, would be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.

before: They took an oath to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and rams’ horns.
after: They took an oath to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and rams’ horns.

before: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn it with all their heart. They had sought Him earnestly, and He was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.
after: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn it with all their heart. They had sought Him earnestly, and He was found by them. So Yahweh gave them rest on every side.

before: So Asa withdrew the silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he sent it with this message to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus:
after: So Asa withdrew the silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of Yahweh and the royal palace, and he sent it with this message to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus:

before: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him, “Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
after: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him, “Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on Yahweh your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

before: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on the LORD, He delivered them into your hand.
after: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on Yahweh, He delivered them into your hand.

before: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
after: For the eyes of Yahweh roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”

before: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa became diseased in his feet, and his disease became increasingly severe. Yet even in his illness he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.
after: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa became diseased in his feet, and his disease became increasingly severe. Yet even in his illness he did not seek Yahweh, but only the physicians.

before: Now the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek the Baals,
after: Now Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek the Baals,

before: So the LORD established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah brought him tribute, so that he had an abundance of riches and honor.
after: So Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah brought him tribute, so that he had an abundance of riches and honor.

before: And his heart took delight in the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.
after: And his heart took delight in the ways of Yahweh; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.

before: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD. They went throughout the towns of Judah and taught the people.
after: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of Yahweh. They went throughout the towns of Judah and taught the people.

before: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
after: And the dread of Yahweh fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.

before: and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for the LORD, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.
after: and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for Yahweh, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.

before: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.”
after: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of Yahweh.”

before: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?”
after: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not still a prophet of Yahweh here of whom we can inquire?”

before: The king of Israel answered, “There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
after: The king of Israel answered, “There is still one man through whom we can inquire of Yahweh, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.” “The king should not say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.

before: Now Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made for himself iron horns and declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’”
after: Now Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made for himself iron horns and declared, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’”

before: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
after: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

before: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever my God tells me.”
after: But Micaiah said, “As surely as Yahweh lives, I will speak whatever my God tells me.”

before: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
after: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of Yahweh?”

before: So Micaiah declared: “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’”
after: So Micaiah declared: “I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And Yahweh said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’”

before: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left.
after: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of Yahweh: I saw Yahweh sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left.

before: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one suggested this, and another that.
after: And Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one suggested this, and another that.

before: Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
after: Then a spirit came forward, stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘By what means?’ asked Yahweh.

before: And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ ‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
after: And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ ‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said Yahweh. ‘Go and do it.’

before: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.”
after: So you see, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, and Yahweh has pronounced disaster against you.”

before: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah went up, struck Micaiah in the face, and demanded, “Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?”
after: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah went up, struck Micaiah in the face, and demanded, “Which way did the Spirit of Yahweh go when He departed from me to speak with you?”

before: But Micaiah replied, “If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Take heed, all you people!”
after: But Micaiah replied, “If you ever return safely, Yahweh has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Take heed, all you people!”

before: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “This is the king of Israel!” So they turned to fight against him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him. God drew them away from him.
after: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “This is the king of Israel!” So they turned to fight against him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him. God drew them away from him.

before: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.
after: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate Yahweh? Because of this, the wrath of Yahweh is upon you.

before: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
after: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

before: Then he said to the judges, “Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for the LORD, who is with you when you render judgment.
after: Then he said to the judges, “Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for Yahweh, who is with you when you render judgment.

before: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
after: And now, may the fear of Yahweh be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with Yahweh our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”

before: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
after: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of Yahweh and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

before: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
after: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of Yahweh.

before: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.
after: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before Yahweh and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.

before: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may the LORD be with the upright!”
after: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to Yahweh, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may Yahweh be with the upright!”

before: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD. And he proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.
after: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek Yahweh. And he proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.

before: So the people of Judah gathered to seek the LORD, and indeed, they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him.
after: So the people of Judah gathered to seek Yahweh, and indeed, they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him.

before: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of the LORD in front of the new courtyard
after: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of Yahweh in front of the new courtyard

before: and said, “O LORD, God of our fathers, are You not the God who is in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand, and no one can stand against You.
after: and said, “O Yahweh, God of our fathers, are You not the God who is in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand, and no one can stand against You.

before: Meanwhile all the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, were standing before the LORD.
after: Meanwhile all the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, were standing before Yahweh.

before: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite from Asaph’s descendants, as he stood in the midst of the assembly.
after: Then the Spirit of Yahweh came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite from Asaph’s descendants, as he stood in the midst of the assembly.

before: And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
after: And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what Yahweh says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.

after: Has Yahweh struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?

after: Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

after: So this is what the Lord Yahweh says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.

after: you will be visited by Yahweh of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.

after: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.

after: Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from Yahweh. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”

after: The humble will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

after: Therefore Yahweh who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.

after: “Woe to the rebellious children,” declares Yahweh, “to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine, who form an alliance, but against My will, heaping up sin upon sin.

after: These are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to obey Yahweh’s instruction.

after: Behold, the Name of Yahweh comes from afar, with burning anger and dense smoke. His lips are full of fury, and His tongue is like a consuming fire.

after: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the Rock of Israel.

after: And Yahweh will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.

after: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of Yahweh; He will strike them with His scepter.

after: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that Yahweh brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.

after: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.

after: Truly, O Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all these countries and their lands.

after: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of Yahweh that you have spoken is good.” For he thought, “At least there will be peace and security in my lifetime.”

after: A voice of one calling: “Prepare the way for Yahweh in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert.

after: But those who wait upon Yahweh will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

after: For I am Yahweh your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.

after: The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

before: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”
after: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of Yahweh has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”

after: “Present your case,” says Yahweh. “Submit your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.

after: This is what God Yahweh says—He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
