before: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
after: I am Yahweh; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.

before: Sing to the LORD a new song—His praise from the ends of the earth—you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
after: Sing to Yahweh a new song—His praise from the ends of the earth—you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.

before: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
after: Let them give glory to Yahweh and declare His praise in the islands.

before: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:
after: Yahweh goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:

before: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
after: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of Yahweh?

before: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
after: Yahweh was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.

before: Who gave Jacob up for spoil, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? They were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.
after: Who gave Jacob up for spoil, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not Yahweh, against whom we have sinned? They were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.

before: But now, this is what the LORD says—He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
after: But now, this is what Yahweh says—He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!

before: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
after: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.

before: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
after: “You are My witnesses,” declares Yahweh, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.

before: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
after: I, yes I, am Yahweh, and there is no Savior but Me.

before: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed—I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
after: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed—I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares Yahweh, “that I am God.

before: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
after: Thus says Yahweh your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.

before: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
after: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”

before: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
after: Thus says Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,

before: This is the word of the LORD, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
after: This is the word of Yahweh, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

before: One will say, ‘I belong to the LORD,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘The LORD’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.”
after: One will say, ‘I belong to Yahweh,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘Yahweh’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.”

before: Thus says the LORD, the King and Redeemer of Israel, the LORD of Hosts: “I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me.
after: Thus says Yahweh, the King and Redeemer of Israel, Yahweh of Hosts: “I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me.

before: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
after: Sing for joy, O heavens, for Yahweh has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.

before: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer who formed you from the womb: “I am the LORD, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by Myself spread out the earth,
after: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer who formed you from the womb: “I am Yahweh, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by Myself spread out the earth,

before: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:
after: This is what Yahweh says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:

before: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.
after: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am Yahweh, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.

before: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
after: I am Yahweh, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,

before: so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other.
after: so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am Yahweh, and there is no other.

before: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
after: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, Yahweh, do all these things.

before: Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it; I, the LORD, have created it.
after: Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it; I, Yahweh, have created it.

before: Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: “Concerning things to come, do you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?
after: Thus says Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: “Concerning things to come, do you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?

before: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free, but not for payment or reward, says the LORD of Hosts.”
after: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free, but not for payment or reward, says Yahweh of Hosts.”

before: This is what the LORD says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you. They will confess to you: ‘God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God.’”
after: This is what Yahweh says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you. They will confess to you: ‘God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God.’”

before: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame or humiliated, to ages everlasting.
after: But Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame or humiliated, to ages everlasting.

before: For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
after: For thus says Yahweh, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am Yahweh, and there is no other.

before: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
after: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, Yahweh, speak the truth; I say what is right.

before: Speak up and present your case—yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
after: Speak up and present your case—yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, Yahweh? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.

before: Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’” All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
after: Surely they will say of Me, ‘In Yahweh alone are righteousness and strength.’” All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.

before: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.
after: In Yahweh all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.

before: Our Redeemer—the LORD of Hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel.
after: Our Redeemer—Yahweh of Hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel.

before: “Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel—but not in truth or righteousness—
after: “Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of Yahweh, who invoke the God of Israel—but not in truth or righteousness—

before: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; the LORD of Hosts is His name.
after: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Hosts is His name.

before: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
after: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? Yahweh’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.

before: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.” And now the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.
after: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.” And now the Lord Yahweh has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.

before: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
after: Thus says Yahweh your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.

before: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!”
after: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “Yahweh has redeemed His servant Jacob!”

before: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
after: “There is no peace,” says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”

before: Listen to Me, O islands; pay attention, O distant peoples: The LORD called Me from the womb; from the body of My mother He named Me.
after: Listen to Me, O islands; pay attention, O distant peoples: Yahweh called Me from the womb; from the body of My mother He named Me.

before: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength in futility and vanity; yet My vindication is with the LORD, and My reward is with My God.”
after: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength in futility and vanity; yet My vindication is with Yahweh, and My reward is with My God.”

before: And now says the LORD, who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant, to bring Jacob back to Him, that Israel might be gathered to Him—for I am honored in the sight of the LORD, and My God is My strength—
after: And now says Yahweh, who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant, to bring Jacob back to Him, that Israel might be gathered to Him—for I am honored in the sight of Yahweh, and My God is My strength—

before: Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the Servant of rulers: “Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.”
after: Thus says Yahweh, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the Servant of rulers: “Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of Yahweh, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.”

before: This is what the LORD says: “In the time of favor I will answer You, and in the day of salvation I will help You; I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land, to apportion its desolate inheritances,
after: This is what Yahweh says: “In the time of favor I will answer You, and in the day of salvation I will help You; I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land, to apportion its desolate inheritances,

before: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
after: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For Yahweh has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.

before: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!”
after: But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!”

before: Lift up your eyes and look around. They all gather together; they come to you. As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “you will wear them all as jewelry and put them on like a bride.
after: Lift up your eyes and look around. They all gather together; they come to you. As surely as I live,” declares Yahweh, “you will wear them all as jewelry and put them on like a bride.

before: This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and raise My banner to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.
after: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and raise My banner to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.

before: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”
after: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am Yahweh; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”

before: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away, and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved; I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
after: Indeed, this is what Yahweh says: “Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away, and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved; I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.

before: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
after: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

before: This is what the LORD says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
after: This is what Yahweh says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.

before: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
after: The Lord Yahweh has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.

before: The Lord GOD has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious, nor have I turned back.
after: The Lord Yahweh has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious, nor have I turned back.

before: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
after: Because the Lord Yahweh helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.

before: Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.
after: Surely the Lord Yahweh helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.

before: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
after: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of Yahweh; let him lean on his God.

before: “Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.
after: “Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek Yahweh: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.

before: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
after: For Yahweh will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.

before: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
after: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahweh. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?

before: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
after: So the redeemed of Yahweh will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.

before: But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
after: But you have forgotten Yahweh, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?

before: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—the LORD of Hosts is His name.
after: For I am Yahweh your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—Yahweh of Hosts is His name.

before: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury; you who have drained the goblet to the dregs—the cup that makes men stagger.
after: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of Yahweh the cup of His fury; you who have drained the goblet to the dregs—the cup that makes men stagger.

before: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the wrath of the LORD, the rebuke of your God.
after: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the wrath of Yahweh, the rebuke of your God.

before: Thus says your Lord, the LORD, even your God, who defends His people: “See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.
after: Thus says your Lord, Yahweh, even your God, who defends His people: “See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.

before: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
after: For this is what Yahweh says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”

before: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
after: For this is what the Lord Yahweh says: “At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.

before: And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
after: And now what have I here? declares Yahweh. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares Yahweh, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.

before: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
after: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when Yahweh returns to Zion.

before: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
after: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for Yahweh has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.

before: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
after: Yahweh has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

before: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.
after: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of Yahweh.

before: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.
after: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for Yahweh goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.

before: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
after: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of Yahweh been revealed?

before: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
after: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.

before: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
after: Yet it was Yahweh’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of Yahweh will prosper in His hand.

before: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
after: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says Yahweh.

before: For your husband is your Maker—the LORD of Hosts is His name—the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
after: For your husband is your Maker—Yahweh of Hosts is His name—the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.

before: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
after: For Yahweh has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.

before: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
after: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.

before: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
after: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says Yahweh, who has compassion on you.

before: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
after: Then all your sons will be taught by Yahweh, and great will be their prosperity.

before: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
after: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of Yahweh, and their vindication is from Me,” declares Yahweh.

before: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
after: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”

before: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
after: Seek Yahweh while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

before: Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
after: Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to Yahweh, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.

before: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
after: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares Yahweh.

before: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up; this will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”
after: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up; this will make a name for Yahweh, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”

before: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
after: For this is what Yahweh says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”

before: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
after: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.

before: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
after: I know, O Yahweh, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.

before: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice—not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
after: Correct me, O Yahweh, but only with justice—not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.

before: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
after: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh:

before: You must tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
after: You must tell them that this is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,

before: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.” “Amen, LORD,” I answered.
after: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.” “Amen, Yahweh,” I answered.

before: Then the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
after: Then Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.

before: And the LORD told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
after: And Yahweh told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.

before: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.
after: Yahweh once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.

before: The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.”
after: Yahweh of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.”

before: And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
after: And Yahweh informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.

before: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
after: O Yahweh of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of Yahweh, or you will die by our hand.”

before: So this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
after: So this is what Yahweh of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

before: Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
after: Righteous are You, O Yahweh, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

before: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
after: But You know me, O Yahweh; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.

before: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other. No flesh has peace.
after: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of Yahweh devours from one end of the earth to the other. No flesh has peace.

before: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.”
after: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.”

before: This is what the LORD says: “As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
after: This is what Yahweh says: “As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

before: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.
after: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as Yahweh lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.

before: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares the LORD.”
after: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares Yahweh.”

before: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”
after: This is what Yahweh said to me: “Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”

before: So I bought a loincloth in accordance with the word of the LORD, and I put it around my waist.
after: So I bought a loincloth in accordance with the word of Yahweh, and I put it around my waist.

before: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
after: Then the word of Yahweh came to me a second time:

before: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD had commanded me.
after: So I went and hid it at Perath, as Yahweh had commanded me.

before: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
after: Many days later Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”

before: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
after: Then the word of Yahweh came to me:

before: “This is what the LORD says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
after: “This is what Yahweh says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

before: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares the LORD, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.
after: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares Yahweh, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.

before: Therefore you are to tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.’ And when they reply, ‘Don’t we surely know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
after: Therefore you are to tell them that this is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.’ And when they reply, ‘Don’t we surely know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’

before: then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.
after: then you are to tell them that this is what Yahweh says: ‘I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.

before: I will smash them against one another, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Me from destroying them.’”
after: I will smash them against one another, fathers and sons alike, declares Yahweh. I will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Me from destroying them.’”

before: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
after: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for Yahweh has spoken.

before: Give glory to the LORD your God before He brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dusky mountains. You wait for light, but He turns it into deep gloom and thick darkness.
after: Give glory to Yahweh your God before He brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dusky mountains. You wait for light, but He turns it into deep gloom and thick darkness.

before: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.
after: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because Yahweh’s flock has been taken captive.

before: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
after: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares Yahweh, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.

before: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
after: This is the word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

before: Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
after: Although our iniquities testify against us, O Yahweh, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.

before: Why are You like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? Yet You are among us, O LORD, and we are called by Your name. Do not forsake us!
after: Why are You like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? Yet You are among us, O Yahweh, and we are called by Your name. Do not forsake us!

before: This is what the LORD says about this people: “Truly they love to wander; they have not restrained their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; He will now remember their iniquity and punish them for their sins.”
after: This is what Yahweh says about this people: “Truly they love to wander; they have not restrained their feet. So Yahweh does not accept them; He will now remember their iniquity and punish them for their sins.”

before: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
after: Then Yahweh said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

before: “Ah, Lord GOD!” I replied, “Look, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine, but I will give you lasting peace in this place.’”
after: “Ah, Lord Yahweh!” I replied, “Look, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine, but I will give you lasting peace in this place.’”

before: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,” replied the LORD. “I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.
after: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,” replied Yahweh. “I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who prophesy in My name: I did not send them, yet they say, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end!
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says about the prophets who prophesy in My name: I did not send them, yet they say, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end!

before: We acknowledge our wickedness, O LORD, the guilt of our fathers; indeed, we have sinned against You.
after: We acknowledge our wickedness, O Yahweh, the guilt of our fathers; indeed, we have sinned against You.

before: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.
after: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O Yahweh our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.

before: Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go!
after: Then Yahweh said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go!

before: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
after: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what Yahweh says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’

before: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
after: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares Yahweh: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

before: You have forsaken Me, declares the LORD. You have turned your back. So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you; I am weary of showing compassion.
after: You have forsaken Me, declares Yahweh. You have turned your back. So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you; I am weary of showing compassion.

before: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,” declares the LORD.
after: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,” declares Yahweh.

before: The LORD said: “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.
after: Yahweh said: “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.

before: You understand, O LORD; remember me and attend to me. Avenge me against my persecutors. In Your patience, do not take me away. Know that I endure reproach for Your honor.
after: You understand, O Yahweh; remember me and attend to me. Avenge me against my persecutors. In Your patience, do not take me away. Know that I endure reproach for Your honor.

before: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
after: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O Yahweh God of Hosts.

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “If you return, I will restore you; you will stand in My presence. And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless, you will be My spokesman. It is they who must turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says: “If you return, I will restore you; you will stand in My presence. And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless, you will be My spokesman. It is they who must turn to you, but you must not turn to them.

before: Then I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to save and deliver you, declares the LORD.
after: Then I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to save and deliver you, declares Yahweh.

before: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
after: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

before: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers who bore them, and the fathers who fathered them in this land:
after: For this is what Yahweh says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers who bore them, and the fathers who fathered them in this land:

before: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,” declares the LORD.
after: Indeed, this is what Yahweh says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,” declares Yahweh.

before: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
after: For this is what Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.

before: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our iniquity? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
after: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has Yahweh pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our iniquity? What is the sin that we have committed against Yahweh our God?’

before: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.
after: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares Yahweh, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.

before: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
after: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares Yahweh, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as Yahweh lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’

before: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
after: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as Yahweh lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.

before: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.
after: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares Yahweh, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.

before: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress, the nations will come to You from the ends of the earth, and they will say, “Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.
after: O Yahweh, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress, the nations will come to You from the ends of the earth, and they will say, “Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.

before: “Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know My power and My might; then they will know that My name is the LORD.
after: “Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know My power and My might; then they will know that My name is Yahweh.

before: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
after: This is what Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from Yahweh.

before: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
after: But blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, whose confidence is in Him.

before: I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
after: I, Yahweh, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.

before: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.
after: O Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned Yahweh, the fountain of living water.

before: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
after: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.

before: Behold, they keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!”
after: Behold, they keep saying to me, “Where is the word of Yahweh? Let it come now!”

before: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; and stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
after: This is what Yahweh said to me: “Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; and stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

before: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, all people of Judah and Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
after: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, O kings of Judah, all people of Judah and Jerusalem who enter through these gates.

before: This is what the LORD says: Take heed for yourselves; do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.
after: This is what Yahweh says: Take heed for yourselves; do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.

before: If, however, you listen carefully to Me, says the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and keep the Sabbath day holy, and do no work on it,
after: If, however, you listen carefully to Me, says Yahweh, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and keep the Sabbath day holy, and do no work on it,

before: And people will come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, and from the foothills, the hill country, and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
after: And people will come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, and from the foothills, the hill country, and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and thank offerings to the house of Yahweh.

before: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
after: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh:

before: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
after: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

before: “O house of Israel, declares the LORD, can I not treat you as this potter treats his clay? Just like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel.
after: “O house of Israel, declares Yahweh, can I not treat you as this potter treats his clay? Just like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel.

before: Now therefore, tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am planning a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways, and correct your ways and deeds.’
after: Now therefore, tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem that this is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am planning a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways, and correct your ways and deeds.’

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard things like these? Virgin Israel has done a most terrible thing.
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says: “Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard things like these? Virgin Israel has done a most terrible thing.

before: Attend to me, O LORD. Hear what my accusers are saying!
after: Attend to me, O Yahweh. Hear what my accusers are saying!

before: But You, O LORD, know all their deadly plots against me. Do not wipe out their guilt or blot out their sin from Your sight. Let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.
after: But You, O Yahweh, know all their deadly plots against me. Do not wipe out their guilt or blot out their sin from Your sight. Let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.

before: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests,
after: This is what Yahweh says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests,

before: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring,
after: saying, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring,

before: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
after: So behold, the days are coming, declares Yahweh, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

before: and you are to proclaim to them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I will shatter this nation and this city, like one shatters a potter’s jar that can never again be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room to bury them.
after: and you are to proclaim to them that this is what Yahweh of Hosts says: I will shatter this nation and this city, like one shatters a potter’s jar that can never again be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room to bury them.

before: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
after: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares Yahweh. I will make this city like Topheth.

after: Then Jeremiah returned from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the courtyard of the house of Yahweh and proclaimed to all the people,

after: “This is what Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am about to bring on this city and on all the villages around it every disaster I have pronounced against them, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to heed My words.’”
