before: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
after: For behold, Yahweh comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

before: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
after: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from Yahweh, even to the gate of Jerusalem.

before: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
after: Therefore this is what Yahweh says: “I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

before: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.
after: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of Yahweh to divide the land by lot.

before: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?
after: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of Yahweh impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?

before: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate, and go out by it. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD as their leader.
after: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate, and go out by it. Their King will pass through before them, Yahweh as their leader.

before: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
after: Then they will cry out to Yahweh, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.

before: This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:
after: This is what Yahweh says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:

before: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
after: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of Yahweh, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.

before: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”
after: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon Yahweh, saying, “Is not Yahweh among us? No disaster can come upon us.”

before: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
after: In the last days the mountain of the house of Yahweh will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.

before: And many nations will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
after: And many nations will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

before: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him. For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken.
after: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him. For the mouth of Yahweh of Hosts has spoken.

before: Though all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
after: Though all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, yet we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

before: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
after: “On that day,” declares Yahweh, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.

before: And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
after: And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation. Then Yahweh will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

before: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued; there the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies!
after: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued; there Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies!

before: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
after: But they do not know the thoughts of Yahweh or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

before: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
after: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to Yahweh, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

before: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
after: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of Yahweh, in the majestic name of Yahweh His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.

before: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.
after: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

before: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
after: “In that day,” declares Yahweh, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.

before: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
after: Hear now what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

before: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
after: Hear, O mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For Yahweh has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:

before: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”
after: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of Yahweh.’”

before: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
after: With what shall I come before Yahweh when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?

before: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
after: Would Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

before: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
after: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does Yahweh require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

before: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
after: The voice of Yahweh calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.

before: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
after: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

before: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
after: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be my light.

before: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
after: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of Yahweh, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.

before: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame—she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
after: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame—she who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.

before: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.
after: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of Yahweh our God; they will tremble in fear of You.

before: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
after: Yahweh is a jealous and avenging God; Yahweh is avenging and full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.

before: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
after: Yahweh is slow to anger and great in power; Yahweh will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

before: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
after: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.

before: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
after: Whatever you plot against Yahweh, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.

before: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
after: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against Yahweh, a counselor of wickedness.

before: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
after: This is what Yahweh says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.

before: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
after: Yahweh has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”

before: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
after: For Yahweh will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.

before: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will reduce your chariots to cinders, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
after: “Behold, I am against you,” declares Yahweh of Hosts. “I will reduce your chariots to cinders, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

before: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
after: “Behold, I am against you,” declares Yahweh of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.

before: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
after: How long, O Yahweh, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?

before: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
after: Are You not from everlasting, O Yahweh, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O Yahweh, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.

before: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
after: Then Yahweh answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.

before: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
after: Is it not indeed from Yahweh of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?

before: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
after: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahweh as the waters cover the sea.

before: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
after: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.

before: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
after: But Yahweh is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.

before: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
after: O Yahweh, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O Yahweh, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!

before: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
after: Were You angry at the rivers, O Yahweh? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?

before: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
after: yet I will exult in Yahweh; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

before: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
after: Yahweh the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.

before: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
after: This is the word of Yahweh that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

before: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
after: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares Yahweh.

before: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
after: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares Yahweh.

before: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
after: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by Yahweh but also swear by Milcom,

before: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.”
after: and those who turn back from following Yahweh, neither seeking Yahweh nor inquiring of Him.”

before: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
after: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of Yahweh is near. Indeed, Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.

before: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of Yahweh is near. Indeed, Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
after: Be silent in the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the Day of Yahweh is near. Indeed, Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.

before: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
after: “On the Day of Yahweh’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.

before: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
after: On that day,” declares Yahweh, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.

before: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
after: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘Yahweh will do nothing, either good or bad.’

before: The great Day of the LORD is near—near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
after: The great Day of Yahweh is near—near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of Yahweh! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.

before: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
after: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

before: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
after: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of Yahweh’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.

before: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you.
after: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of Yahweh comes upon you, before the Day of Yahweh’s anger comes upon you.

before: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.
after: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of Yahweh’s anger.

before: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
after: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of Yahweh is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”

before: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.
after: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for Yahweh their God will attend to them and restore their captives.

after: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares Yahweh of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah—a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”

before: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
after: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of Yahweh of Hosts.

before: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.
after: Yahweh will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.

after: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in Yahweh; she has not drawn near to her God.

before: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
after: Yahweh within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.

before: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation—all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
after: Therefore wait for Me,” declares Yahweh, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation—all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.

before: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
after: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of Yahweh and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.

before: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
after: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of Yahweh.

before: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
after: Yahweh has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, Yahweh, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.

before: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
after: Yahweh your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

before: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.

after: that this is what Yahweh of Hosts says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of Yahweh.’”

after: Then the word of Yahweh came through Haggai the prophet, saying:

after: Now this is what Yahweh of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.

before: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
after: This is what Yahweh of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.

before: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
after: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says Yahweh.
